title: Five reported defects in a small inventory package, one with a failing test

requirements.text: restock adds to the existing quantity
Separate Inventory objects do not share items
CSV export stays parseable when a name contains commas or quotes
low_stock includes items exactly at the threshold
Discounts round half up to the nearest cent
A regression test exists for each of the five defects
Changes are minimal: modules are not rewritten and existing tests are kept
